regression.user_input: 左じゃなくて右を見て。
regression.observed_representation_issue: The broad gaze.left grounding anchor spans the later right target text even though V48 correctly assigns the negation marker only to gaze.left. The event map exposes both target_id and broad anchor_text, which can give the 4B model conflicting evidence.

historical_control_boundary.interpretation: The V51 matched comparison is internally controlled, but it is not an exact reproduction of the historical V46 output because V51 used a separately frozen seed and context window. Historical and V51 control scores must not be merged as if they were the same run.

interpretation: The answer-free event representation produced a large matched development gain and removed both observed false actions, so explicit target-local structure is useful. It still cannot advance because one previously correct contrastive replacement regressed. The problem is now localized to separating a precise target mention span from a broader predicate-grounding span, not to model size alone.

next_research.scope: Preregister a separate precise-target-mention representation experiment. Keep the V51 prompt, model, event ordering, taxonomy, and V48 compiler fixed; change only how each grounded occurrence distinguishes its exact target mention from broad predicate evidence.
